Welcome to blog. I'm Daniel and intend to write about topics such as statistical modeling, machine learnign, biomechanical research, music, or whatever comes to my mind (admitttedly, currently, this is far less frequent than I'd like).

I’m a big fan of Free and Open Source Software, as well as the idea of open science in general. You’ll usually find me coding in R and Python. I am the author of the R package [funbootband](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/funbootband/index.html).

Off the clock, I switch gears and jam on my bass and guitar. 🎸 If you are into Doom/Stoner music, check out my band Ufo Krause [Ufo Krause](https://ufokrause.org/)
